name: Data Use Agreement for a Limited Data Set (HIPAA)
description: The agreement a HIPAA covered entity must have before it discloses a limited data set for research, public health or health care operations. The checks read for the seven terms the Privacy Rule requires it to contain: the permitted uses, who may use or receive the data, and the recipient's five commitments — no other use, safeguards, reporting, the same terms for agents, and no re-identification or contact. Distinct from `data-sharing-agreement`, which reads a general data-sharing arrangement, and from `baa`, which covers a business associate.

title_keywords: data use agreement for a limited data set
limited data set data use agreement

compliance_matrix_columns: Permitted uses, within research, public health or health care operations
Who may use or receive the limited data set
No use or disclosure beyond the agreement, except as required by law
